correctness.rationale: PASS: For k algebraically closed of characteristic zero and a,b>=2 the dimension d=a+b-1, codimension c=(a-1)(b-1) rank-one determinantal presentation supplies a c-minor Jacobian Fitting ideal. Each Jacobian entry is linear, giving Fitt_d(Omega_A) subset m^c. The c anchored quadrics z11*zij-zi1*z1j have the interior-column Jacobian matrix z11 I_c; its determinant z11^c is a nonzero class in A. The intrinsic Fitting ideal is GL_a x GL_b stable; its degree-c piece is a nonzero submodule of Sym^c(k^a) tensor Sym^c(k^b), which is an irreducible product-group representation in char0. Thus the entire A_c occurs and m^c subset Fitt; equality follows. This representation-theoretic step, rather than any finite calculation, covers all a,b. Counting degree t monomials u^alpha v^beta yields length L=sum_{t<c}binom(a+t-1,t)binom(b+t-1,t). On each projective chart z_B !=0 of Delta(r,n), all ratios are products of single-exchange t_j/t_i; the row/column toric relations are 2x2 minors (contingency 2x2 swaps), so the local ring is A_{r,n-r}. Its only singular point is the rank-zero origin. Disjoint local lengths yield total binom(n,r)L. Independent symbolic derivative checks of rectangles (2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(3,3),(3,4) confirmed the distinguished diagonal pivot and exact lengths 1,7,39,146,1974; these sample checks are not an infinite proof. Scope 2<=r<=n-2; r=1,n-1 smooth. Does not claim a characteristic-p version or Hilbert-Samuel multiplicity.
